6534.title: Delayed preference broadcasts restore superseded sidebar state
6534.rootCauseOneLine: The pending-write guard ends at RPC completion, allowing delayed self-broadcasts to overwrite newer local preferences; per-key writes can also overlap.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — addresses both mechanisms in principle
prReviews.topFinding: No linked PR code was executed; origin filtering and serialization target the observed races.

6534.proposedFix: Correlate writes with their originating window, ignore that window's own echoes, and serialize writes per preference key while retaining the latest queued value.
6534.caveats: Reproduced at the production preference-state boundary twice. Browser animation, remote frequency, real server write reordering and the linked PR runtime remain unverified. Chrome runtime prerequisites were unavailable.
